Engineering in Plain Sight: An Illustrated Field Guide to the Constructed Environment is a 2022 non-fiction book by civil engineer Grady Hillhouse , published by No Starch Press .

Content

[ edit ]
The book is organized into eight functional chapters, using detailed illustrations to catalog various types of civil infrastructure:
* Chapter 1. Electrical Grid
* Chapter 2. Communications
* Chapter 3. Roadways
* Chapter 4. Bridges and Tunnels
* Chapter 5. Railways
* Chapter 6. Dams , Levees , and Coastal structures
* Chapter 7. Municipal Water and Wastewater
* Chapter 8. Construction

Author Bio
Grady Hillhouse is a civil engineer and science communicator widely known for his educational video series Practical Engineering , currently one of the largest engineering channels on YouTube with over 4.5 million subscribers and millions of views each month. His videos, which focus on infrastructure and the human-made environment, have garnered media attention from around the world and been featured on both the Science Channel and Discovery Channel in addition to many other publications.
